subject: Deployment ownership route and 30-day milestone compact
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elaine Turner <elaine.turner@crestline-dx.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 8 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Deployment ownership route and 30-day milestone compact

Elaine — thanks again for signing with Redwood. Quick note to kick off the internal handoff so we can hit the target go-live of Jan 12 and minimize lift on your side. Key commercial summary is below and I've attached the SOW v3 for reference.

- Plan: Dedicated pool (2x A100 equiv), 8 onboarding hours included, standard data-retention settings.
- SLA: 99.9% uptime, 95th percentile latency target 120ms for standard routes.
- Licensing: Up to 5 production models in the catalog; burst capacity options available.

Monica (CS): please lead the kickoff and own post-sign project delivery.
Karthik (Implementation): please scope staging timeline and any infra pre-reqs.

Attachments: Crestline_SOW_v3.pdf
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/231223/DL-2026-0783

Next steps: Monica to schedule kickoff and share 30-day milestone plan. Elaine — can your team do the week of Dec 13 for an initial alignment call? If not, Jan 3 is fine.

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Director, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwoodinference.com>, Elaine Turner <elaine.turner@crestline-dx.com>, Adam Li <adam.li@crestline-dx.com>
Date: Tue, 8 Dec 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Deployment ownership route and 30-day milestone compact

Thanks Jonas — looping in Tessa for ops cadence and Adam on the Crestline side. Elaine, hi — Monica from Customer Success. I’ll run the kickoff and own the delivery plan. Quick clarifying questions before I lock timelines so Karthik can size the implementation sprint: 

1) Which environment will you want the initial staging in? (US-west or EU-prod)
2) Any strict IP allowlists or VPC peering required; do you have a preferred KMS for keying?
3) Are there any custom model ops (private fine-tune artifacts) we need to onboard during sprint0?

I’ll draft a 30-day milestone spreadsheet (internal) with owners: CSM cadence, implementation deliverables, acceptance criteria and 7/15/30 day checkpoints. Tentatively proposing kickoff Dec 14 10am PT — Elaine/Adam can you confirm?

Best,
Monica Patel
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

Cc: Elaine Turner <elaine.turner@crestline-dx.com>, Adam Li <adam.li@crestline-dx.com>
Date: Tue, 8 Dec 2026 11:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Deployment ownership route and 30-day milestone compact

Monica — a few answers to your questions to unblock scoping: 

1) Start staging in US-west (us-west-2). Production will land in the same region; Crestline requested low-latency to their west-coast clinics.
2) Crestline prefers KMS via AWS KMS (account id 987654321). No VPC peering required — they will use our dedicated pool with private endpoints, but they asked for an allowlist for our egress IPs.
3) They will not bring custom fine-tunes for sprint0; initial models are in our curated catalog and a private embedding set to migrate later in month two.

Also FYI on commercial levers: we included 8 onboarding hours in SOW; any additional SRE/time will be charged per the support addendum. If CS needs additional ramp hours, flag me and I’ll request a one-time onboarding credit (sales approval).

I’ve attached the Mutual Action Plan tracker for milestone alignment.

Links: Mutual action plan: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcdE_mAP-tracker
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/231223/DL-2026-0783

Thanks — Jonas

Date: Tue, 8 Dec 2026 13:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Deployment ownership route and 30-day milestone compact — kickoff plan and owners

Team — I put together an ops kickoff packet and a compact 30-day milestone plan attached (ops_kickoff_agenda.docx, Mutual_Action_Plan_Crestline.xlsx). Owner assignments: 

- CSM / Project lead: Monica Patel (overall success owner; weekly checkpoints)
- Implementation lead: Karthik Iyer (staging, infra, smoke tests)
- Ops contact: Tessa Morgan (billing/capacity routing, SLA reporting hooks)
- Customer POC: Elaine Turner (Ops Director) / Adam Li (Platform Eng)

Proposed kickoff: Tue Dec 14, 10:00am PT — 60 minute call (alignment + sprint0 acceptance criteria). Monica to send calendar invite and dial-in.

Acceptance criteria for sprint0 (30 days):
- Staging environment provisioned in us-west-2 with private endpoints
- KV/prefix caching enabled for test routes
- Smoke tests: 1000 requests at 20rps with <200ms median latency
- Baseline telemetry dashboards created in Console and shared with Crestline

Attachments: ops_kickoff_agenda.docx, Mutual_Action_Plan_Crestline.xlsx

Jonas — if you think we’ll need extra onboarding hours beyond the included 8, flag and we’ll request the onboarding credit you mentioned.

Monica Patel
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

Monica / Jonas — thanks for the clear plan and ownership. Dec 14 10am PT works for our team. A couple of procurement/security notes ahead of kickoff so you can route pre-reqs: 

- Procurement contact for contract orchestration: procure@crestline-dx.com (CC'd). Please route SOW and invoice instructions there after the kickoff.
- Security: our vendor security team (vendorsec@crestline-dx.com) needs an initial SOC 2 Type II cert and data retention policy; attaching vendorsec contact to loop into the kickoff.
- IP allowlist: we will provide the target CIDR block for connections by EOD tomorrow.

We confirm no custom model artifacts for sprint0; we will plan migration of proprietary embeddings in month two. Also please include a note in the kickoff agenda about telemetry dashboard access for our analytics team.

See you on the 14th — Elaine Turner
Director, Operations
Crestline Diagnostics
